claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_aura (class-feature family)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Aura of Courage is always-on: no activation cost, no use count, no reset cadence. The single existing class-feature family ('activation') requires all three, making any encoding dishonest. A 'passive_aura' family is needed whose mechanics header carries only an aura scope (radius + reference to the named aura) and a persistent effect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You and your allies have Immunity to the Frightened condition while in your Aura of Protection.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_condition_immunity
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants Immunity (not resistance) to the Frightened condition. The v4 atom inventory has 'grant_resistance' and 'apply_condition'/'remove_condition', but Immunity is a distinct game concept in SRD 5.2.1 (separate rule tier from resistance). No existing v4 effect atom covers it.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You and your allies have Immunity to the Frightened condition while in your Aura of Protection.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: aura_scope attachment for class features
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The aura's spatial scope ('while in your Aura of Protection') is a named, always-active radius around the paladin. The current Attachment union (self / target / area / mark) is designed for spells with cast-time targeting. Class feature auras need a distinct attachment variant that references a named aura by id and a radius, without a one-time selection.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: while in your Aura of Protection / If a Frightened ally enters the aura
